description: Manages DNS records using the Netcup API, see the docs https://ccp.netcup.net/run/webservice/servers/endpoint.php.

parameters.name: api_key
parameters.description: API key for authentication, must be obtained using the netcup CCP (https://ccp.netcup.net).

parameters.name: api_password
parameters.description: API password for authentication, must be obtained using the netcup CCP (https://ccp.netcup.net).

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Domainname the records should be added / removed.

parameters.name: record
parameters.description: Record to add or delete, supports wildcard (*). Default is @ (that is, the zone name). Default: "@"

parameters.name: solo
parameters.description: Whether the record should be the only one for that record type and record name. Only use with state=present. This deletes all other records with the same record name and type. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether the record should exist or not. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: HTTP(S) connection timeout in seconds. Default: 5

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Record type. Support for OPENPGPKEY, SMIMEA and SSHFP was added in community.general 8.1.0. Record types OPENPGPKEY and SMIMEA require nc-dnsapi >= 0.1.5. Record type SSHFP requires nc-dnsapi >= 0.1.6. Choices: "A" "AAAA" "MX" "CNAME" "CAA" "SRV" "TXT" "TLSA" "NS" "DS" "OPENPGPKEY" "SMIMEA" "SSHFP"

examples:
- name: Create a record of type A
  community.general.netcup_dns:
    api_key: "..."
    api_password: "..."
    customer_id: "..."
    domain: "example.com"
    name: "mail"
    type: "A"
    value: "127.0.0.1"

- name: Delete that record
  community.general.netcup_dns:
    api_key: "..."
    api_password: "..."
    customer_id: "..."
    domain: "example.com"
    name: "mail"
    type: "A"
    value: "127.0.0.1"
    state: absent

- name: Create a wildcard record
  community.general.netcup_dns:
    api_key: "..."
    api_password: "..."
    customer_id: "..."
    domain: "example.com"
    name: "*"
    type: "A"
    value: "127.0.1.1"

- name: Set the MX record for example.com
  community.general.netcup_dns:
    api_key: "..."
    api_password: "..."
    customer_id: "..."
    domain: "example.com"
    type: "MX"
    value: "mail.example.com"

- name: Set a record and ensure that this is the only one
  community.general.netcup_dns:
    api_key: "..."
    api_password: "..."
    customer_id: "..."
    name: "demo"
    domain: "example.com"
    type: "AAAA"
    value: "::1"
    solo: true

- name: Increase the connection timeout to avoid problems with an unstable connection
  community.general.netcup_dns:
    api_key: "..."
    api_password: "..."
    customer_id: "..."
    domain: "example.com"
    name: "mail"
    type: "A"
    value: "127.0.0.1"
    timeout: 30

return_values.name: records
return_values.description: List containing all records. Returned: success

return_values.name: id
return_values.description: Internal ID of the record. Returned: success Sample: 12345

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: The record name. Returned: success Sample: "fancy-hostname"

return_values.name: priority
return_values.description: The record priority (only relevant if records[].type=MX). Returned: success Sample: 0

return_values.name: type
return_values.description: The record type. Returned: success Sample: "A"

return_values.name: value
return_values.description: The record destination. Returned: success Sample: "127.0.0.1"
